en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything moved to the empty
classroom has been put back here.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a large wooden dog statue on the
pedestal. It looks pretty old.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the statue weren't here,
or the cage or the sheet...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think I'll ever forget that
katana in the effigy...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's packed with books and scrolls...
They're all weathered and old.

I don't think I could read all of these
if I had a million years...

<CLT=cltMIND>The book on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltMIND>
is gone...

<CLT=cltMIND>If Kiyo found out, he would probably
"tear their nerves out"...

<CLT=cltMIND>The book on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltMIND>
is gone...
